Snapshot filename parsing, latest pair selection, and old snapshot removal helpers.

# Purpose
This header declares snapshot archive utility functions for working with snapshot files on disk. The [`fd_ssarchive_parse_filename`](<#fd_ssarchive_parse_filename>) function parses snapshot file names into slot values and an optional base58-decoded hash, while [`fd_ssarchive_latest_pair`](<#fd_ssarchive_latest_pair>) scans a directory to find the newest valid full and incremental snapshot pair and returns their paths. The [`fd_ssarchive_remove_old_snapshots`](<#fd_ssarchive_remove_old_snapshots>) function removes older snapshot files so the directory keeps only the requested number of full and incremental snapshots.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_ssarchive_parse_filename`
- `fd_ssarchive_latest_pair`
- `fd_ssarchive_remove_old_snapshots`
